sar.narrative: Customer C11000, holder of card C11000-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-28 and 2016-12-28, 4 transaction(s) totalling $10,182.41 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3581258 and the transaction that triggered review being 3581276 for $2,557.24. The activity was conducted through the card-present channel in billing region 315.0. Card-present purchases were made in a billing region in which the cardholder has no history, while their ordinary activity continued elsewhere, indicating the instrument was cloned rather than travelling. Closed investigation CC-1039 recorded cleared on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.92 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $10,182.41.
